name: plan_j_ermont
label: The plan, line J from Ermont and by Poissy to Nord-Est
about: Line J trains no longer end at the surface of Saint-Lazare: they use the underground platforms of RER F and run on to Nord-Est in 4 minutes, in the room RER F leaves in its tunnel (23 trains an hour for a limit of 32). Where they turn or run on beyond Nord-Est is left open (ASSUMPTION: they end at Nord-Est). The 6 trains an hour from Ermont-Eaubonne and the 3 by Houilles and Poissy.
